scripts.install:all: cd server && pnpm install && cd ../client && pnpm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && pnpm dev" "cd client && pnpm dev"
scripts.build: cd server && pnpm build && cd ../client && pnpm build
scripts.seed: cd server && pnpm exec tsx src/db/seed.ts
scripts.setup: pnpm install:all && pnpm migrate && pnpm seed
